messages:
Rae: Quick UX pass from the console review — dark theme still has a few legibility pain points: token hover is bright, syntax highlights feel washed on the code panel, and heatmap color ramp collapses in the darkest bins. Can we propose fixes?
Jun: Noted. For token hover my preference is flattening (lower saturation) + subtle inner shadow instead of brightening. Example: `--token-bg: #0a0b0c; --token-hover: #151617; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.35);`
Owen: For syntax highlights, on dark bg the green/cyan hues lose pop at smaller font sizes. Consider slightly boosting luminance for keyword/token colors and keeping background of code blocks a touch lighter (not full light) — maybe `--code-bg: #0f1011`.
Mika: Heatmap problem: our low-value bins on #08090a are nearly indistinguishable. Options: 1) add a thin outline between cells at 10% alpha, 2) shift ramp to include a warmer mid-tone, 3) add optional pattern (dot) overlay for the lowest bin in Accessibility mode.
Rae: I like 2 + 3. Keep outlines subtle so it doesn't look grid-like. Patterns should be optional and under Settings > Accessibility.
Jun: Pattern design question: hatch vs dots? Dots read cleaner at small sizes. Suggest `pattern-dots` for heatmap, `pattern-hatch` for area fills. Also scale dot radius by devicePixelRatio to avoid moiré.
Owen: Implementation note: use SVG <pattern> with `patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"` and scale with DPR. For outlines, `stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.03)` works on dark bg.
Mika: Microcopy for toggle: candidates — "Accessible chart patterns", "Chart patterns (increase legibility)", "Enable patterns for colorblindness". Leaning to short + explanatory tooltip.
Rae: Vote: "Accessible chart patterns" + tooltip: "Overlay patterns to help distinguish series or bins when colors are hard to tell apart." Keep the toggle default off and auto-enable when prefers-contrast: more or when analyzer detects low contrast.
design-bot: Tokens proposed (staging): --token-hover-flat: #151617, --code-bg: #0f1011, --heatmap-outline: rgba(255,255,255,0.03), --chart-patterns-enabled: false.
Owen: A11y ask: add `aria-describedby` on charts when patterns are active with a short message for screen readers. Also emit an analytics event when auto-enable triggers so we can measure prevalence.
qa-bot: Scheduling contrast checks for token hover and code bg on branch=feature/dark-legibility-218, job=ui-contrast-511.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued — branch=feature/dark-legibility-218 job=ci-ux-511
Rae: Thanks — I'll test on beta after deploy and upload screenshots. If the contrast checks fail we'll iterate on the token hover/luminance. :camera_flash:
